findings.summary: Draftail rich-text textboxes have no accessible name, including fifteen fields on the recipe editor.
findings.fix: Give each visible contenteditable textbox aria-labelledby pointing to its field or block label, or an equivalent translated aria-label; propagate this through Draftail options for both ordinary fields and StreamField widgets.
findings.evidence: Runtime /admin/pages/82/edit/: axe aria-input-field-name finds 15 role=textbox contenteditables without aria-label or aria-labelledby. A label targeting the hidden backing input does not name the visible editor.

findings.summary: Form-submission selection checkboxes have no names, so screen-reader users cannot identify the select-all control or selected record.
findings.fix: Label the header checkbox “Select all submissions” and label each row checkbox “Select submission …” with a meaningful row identifier, using labels or aria-label.
findings.evidence: Runtime /admin/forms/submissions/69/: axe label flags header checkbox data-w-bulk-target=all and row checkbox name=selected-submissions; source lines 12 and 24 contain no labels.

findings.summary: Multiple image and document upload file inputs have no accessible name.
findings.fix: Use an associated label for #fileupload in both upload templates; retain the visible “Or choose from your computer” text as the input name. Associate accepted-format and size instructions with aria-describedby.
findings.evidence: Runtime /admin/images/multiple/add/ and /admin/documents/multiple/add/: axe label flags #fileupload. Adjacent button text is not programmatically associated. Document template also has the input at line 26.

findings.summary: Tag-it replaces the labeled tag field with an unnamed text input.
findings.fix: After tag-it initializes, give its generated input an ID and associate the existing Tags label with it, or copy the field label through aria-labelledby; also preserve relevant descriptions and invalid state.
findings.evidence: Runtime /admin/images/51/, /admin/documents/edit/2/, /admin/pages/68/edit/ and /admin/pages/77/edit/: axe label flags .ui-autocomplete-input. vendor/tag-it.js:130 creates <input type=text> without an ID/name association; TagController.connect does not supply one.

findings.summary: StreamField field errors are displayed beside inputs but are not programmatically associated with those inputs.
findings.fix: Include the existing ${prefix}-errors container in the widget aria-describedby tokens when invalid, preserving help-text tokens, and remove the error token when clear. Ensure custom widgets propagate the association to their interactive control.
findings.evidence: Source: error container has id=${prefix}-errors (line 24); setError appends text and sets invalid state (123–146); getAttributes only describes ${prefix}-helptext (160–161). No error ID is passed to the widget.

findings.summary: Draftail does not propagate field instructions and validation descriptions from its hidden backing field to the interactive textbox.
findings.fix: Read and preserve the backing field aria-describedby tokens and pass them to Draftail ariaDescribedBy, adding the length counter rather than replacing them; propagate aria-invalid to the visible textbox as validation changes.
findings.evidence: initEditor sets ariaDescribedBy=null, only substitutes the length-counter ID at 199, and passes it at 251; BoundDraftailWidget.setInvalid only changes the hidden input at 343. Field help/error IDs supplied by FieldPanel are not used.

passed: Shared formatted fields render associated labels, separately identified help and error containers. FieldPanel passes aria-describedby and aria-invalid for ordinary supported widgets.
User creation password fields explicitly set autocomplete=new-password.
Collection permission option checkboxes have visually hidden associated labels.
notes: Archive POST validation, upload completion and server-side error responses were not exercised; these require a live writable test environment.
StreamField error association and Draftail validation-description propagation are source-confirmed findings; interactive invalid-state runtime testing is pending.
No missing autocomplete finding is asserted for editing another user’s information; WCAG 1.3.5 concerns information about the person using the form.
